about: The tests Trillion-X/trillion PR #243 (4ffa1dc4a2) deleted with no home and no port-backlog row (its backlog listed only source and data), carried byte for byte from the tag old-trillion-before-worker-retire into the Workshop tool that now holds the code each one tests. Each group is one tool and the tests whose subject it holds; every file they import is already home in this repository (an earlier lane moved it), so only the tests and their test help move. docs/pr243-deleted-tests.json lists every such test and where it went. Test help a test reads by its address (a fixture page) is named as an owner of its group, since the import closure does not follow a path read.
